prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1419; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across the center and the left taillight assembly is broken, with scuffing and paint transfer along the left quarter panel. The damage pattern lines up with the low-speed impact described in the account, and nothing I found suggests older harm to these areas. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover, the taillight assembly, and refinishing the affected panel. The labor hours listed fit the scope of this work, and the parts and charges on the invoices are billed once with no duplicated line items. No prior damage to this vehicle is on record.
